summary: Add a like from the authenticated user to a track
description: Lets the authenticated user (specified by access_token) like the given track_id. If the track does not exist no error is raised, but the like will not appear in any read request. Requires a valid client_id and an OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with 'music' scope for the user

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the track to like

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes the total count of possible results in the response header (performance impact)

notes: No error is returned if the specified track does not exist; the like will simply not be recorded.
Requires the OAuth2 'music' scope; a simple API key alone is insufficient.
